title: Cloudflare Clef 27B via Ollama (18 GB)
slug_note: Cloudflare's 27B decision model in one command; fits a 24 GB card at Q4.

variation.quant_detail: Ollama's clef:latest = clef:27b-q4_k_m, 18 GB (q8_0 30 GB tag also exists)

requirements.notes: Estimate: 18 GB tag plus KV headroom.

steps.text: Install Ollama (see Step 0 in Quick start).

caveats: Decision model: it answers typed questions with probabilities on /v1/systemone; it does not chat, so OpenCode and chat UIs cannot use it.
Benchmarks on the card (Decision Index rows vs Jev) are Cloudflare's own.

sources.note: model card with the Decision Index table
